children: Overview
UK consulting firm's H1 2026 revenue grew 25% yr/yr, adjusted diluted EPS rose 18%
Company's AI-related revenue increased 185% yr/yr to £8.1m
Free cash flow declined due to acquisition payments and seasonal factors
Outlook
Elixirr expects FY 26 adjusted EBITDA to be in line with company-compiled market expectations
Firm expects FY 26 revenue to be broadly in line with company-compiled market expectations
Company sees significant growth opportunity from AI-related consulting demand
Result Drivers
AI-RELATED GROWTH - Co said AI-related revenue rose 185% yr/yr to £8.1m, driven by larger client engagements and focus on embedding AI into operations
CLIENT EXPANSION - Co deepened relationships with major clients, with more clients generating over £1m and £2m in revenue
ACQUISITIONS & CROSS-SELL - Acquisitions and increased cross-sell revenue contributed to growth, including new presence in Nordics and expanded offerings
